What then is the meaning of the pillar of fire? We
need the fire in the night, when it is dark. But the meaning is
the same as that of the cloud. The cloud is the fire, and the
fire is the cloud. When the sun shines, the Lord’s presence
takes the appearance of a cloud; when darkness comes,
it takes the appearance of fire. It is the same entity with
different appearances. Then what does the fire represent?
It represents the Word. The cloud is the Spirit, and the fire is
the Word. When the sun is shining, you are very clear in the
Spirit; you can easily follow the cloud. But many times it
is just like night and you are in darkness. You cannot trust
your spirit; your spirit is very much perplexed. In such a
situation, you must trust the Word. The Word is like the
fire, burning, shining, and enlightening. Psalm 119:105
says, “Thy word is a lamp unto my feet, and a light unto my
path.” When the sky is so clear and everything is so bright,

source: Internal Debts: A sum of ₹ 2,429.00 crore is estimated to be received from Internal Debts of the State.Internal Debts include various loans such as Market Loans which is projected at ₹ 900.00 crore, NABARD Loan is kept at ₹ 170.00 crore, National Co-operative Development Corporation Loan capped at ₹ 5.00 crore, Rural Electricity Corporation at ₹ 2.00 crore, Power Financing Corporation loan estimated at ₹ 2.00 crore and SIDBI loan of ₹ 350.00 crore.The Government vows to continue rural infrastructure development works through NABARD loans.Some of the major projects approved for funding under NABARD RIDF XXVII are Construction of CHCs, PHCs etc. & for Infrastructure and Logistic Supplies for Fighting the Ongoing Covid Pandemic with a total project outlay of ₹ 27.25 crore, Upgradation of Existing 17.9 km Road to Cement Concrete Pavement from Meidum - Hortoki (Phase-II) with a project amount of ₹ 133.66 crore, Construction of Separate 11kV Feeders for Power Supply to Agricultural Lands amounting to ₹ 12.25 crore, Soil Conservation Measures for Enhancement of Productivity in Mizoram with a total project cost of ₹ 10.00 crore and Six Irrigation Projects in Mizoram with a project amount of ₹ 10.47 crore. source: HON'BLE UNION MINISTER SHRI PARSHOTTAM RUPALA MEETS MAMIT DISTRICT OFFICIALS AND BENEFICIARIES. 83/2022-2023 Mamit 13th June, 2022: Shri PARSHOTTAM Rupala, Hon'ble Union Cabinet Minister, Fisheries, Animal Husbandry & Dairying today held a meeting with a District Officials and Beneficiaries of various centrally sponsor schemes at the conference hall of DC Mamit. The meeting was chaired by Pu Lalnunhlua DC Mamit. The Minister was appraised about the aspirational District programme undertakings and the present status in the delta ranking through power point presentation by Pu Lalsanglura, Nodal Officer of Aspirational District. Hon'ble Union Minister mentioned his purpose for his visited of the District and interaction with the Beneficiaries of various scheme. He assured full support for the proper implementation of the schemes so that the beneficiaries can enjoy the benefits as intended by the Government. In the meeting the Minister Interacted with the officials and beneficiaries of the following Central Scheme: AYUSHMAN BHARAT Health & Wellness, Ayushman Bharat Jan Arogya Yojana, e- Transaction, Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana (PMJDY), PM Street Vendor's Atma Nirbhar nidhi ( PM-Svanidhi), Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana (PMUY), Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana ( Gramin/Urban), Jal Jeevan Mission ( Individual household connection & Schools), Swachh Bharat Mission (Urban/Gramin), PMMVY and PM-Kisan. Union minister is accompanied by the Director, Fisheries Department, Government of Mizoram and other Officials from Aizawl. Attachment Loading attachment...

Vawiin thutkhawm Pu Lalnunhlua, District Bawrhsap kaihhruaiah hian Aspirational District Programme hnuaia hmalakna hrang hrangte Pu Lalsanglura, Aspirational District Programme Nodal Officer chuan Power point presentation hmangin chipchiar takin a tarlang a. Hmasawnna awmte leh hmachhawp/tanlakna tur hrang hrangte sawiho zui nghal a ni. Shri Parshottam Rupala, Union Minister chuan Mamit District a rawn tlawh chhan leh inkawmhona neih anih chhan sawiin Central Schemes hrang hrang District mipuite'n an hlawhtlinpui theih nan leh tha taka kalpui anih leh nih loh thlithlai a, harsatna awm angte hrechianga sutkianpui tura lokal anih thu a sawi a. District Concern Officers te pawhin Sorkar hmalakna Programme hrang hrang zirchiang a, beneficiaries te'n an hlawhtlinpui ngei theih nana tan la turin a fuih. Mamit District chu Aspirational District anih angin natna khirhkhan bik inenkawlna atan cheng Nuai 5 thleng bill theih turin ruahmanna Central-in a siam a, Mamit District chhungah mi sing 5 thlanchhuah atanga sing 3 te chu dawng tura thlanchhuah an nih tawh thu sawiin, a bak sing 2 pawh hian an hmuh theih nan hmalakpui mek an nih thu a sawi bawk. PM-Kisan chu Aadhaar Card, ram leh Bank Account nei tan dil theih anih thu sawiin, a concern department te pawhin Mamit District chhunga kuthnathawktute'n he scheme atanga hlawkna mi tam thei ang berin an dawn theih nana tan la turin a chah bawk. Union Minister hian vawiin inkawmhona-a Sorkar Officials leh Beneficiaries te'n an harsatna leh mamawh an lo thlente chu a theih ang anga bawhzuisak a tum thu a sawi a ni. He hunah hian Central Schemes hrang hrang AYUSHMAN BHARAT - Health & Wellness, Ayushman Bharat - Jan Arogya Yojana, e-Transaction, Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana (PMJDY), PM Street Vendor's Atma Nirbhar nidhi (PM-Svanidhi), Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana (PMUY), Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana (Gramin/Urban), Jal Jeevan Mission (individual household connection & Schools), Swachh Bharat Mission (Urban/Gramin), PMMVY leh PM-Kisan hnuaia Beneficiaries te leh a changtu Officials te kawmna neiin zawhna leh chhanna hun hman zui a ni bawk. As per the draft electoral roll, there are 31372 voters (15852 males and 15520 females) in 36-Tuichawng (ST) A/C, 26926 voters (13524 males and 13402 females) in 37-Lawngtlai West (ST) A/C and 24000 voters (11626 males and 12374 females) in 38-Lawngtlai East (ST) A/C. In total, there are 82298 voters (41002 males and 41296 females) in Lawngtlai District. Claims and objections regarding the draft roll can be filed upto 15th January, 2020. The qualifying date for the roll is 1st January, 2020. Final electoral roll is scheduled to be published on 7th February, 2020. Meanwhile, 8 new polling stations in addition to the existing 62 stations in Tuichawng Constituency, 1 new polling station in addition to the existing 68 stations in Lawngtlai West Constituency and 7 new polling stations in addition to the existing 35 stations in Lawngtlai East Constituency are created resulting to the total number of 181 polling stations in Lawngtlai District. quite simple. There is a stream in me which is connected

spring. The more the living water flows out, the more the

to speak. If I stop speaking, it stops coming. This stream is
flowing all the time.”

source:
Not long after I was released from prison, I became
seriously ill with tuberculosis. I was confined to bed for six
months of absolute rest, followed by two and a half years
of greatly restricted activity for recovery. Outwardly speak-
ing, those days were really dark. But, I tell you, whenever
I prayed I felt that I was not in bed. but in the heavens.
Though I was gravely ill, yet when I prayed I had the sense
that I was not in illness, but far above it all in the heavens.
You do not know what kind of pleasure I had in the Lord
in those days. Imprisonment and persecution, then poverty
and illness. But, praise the Lord, the ascended Christ was
my way! The transcendent Christ was my way to the
heavens.

this day.”

source: AGRI-MARKETING & TRAINING INFRASTRUCTURE BUILDING INAUGURATED AT LUNGLEI No.523/2021-2022 Aizawl, the 28th February 2022 : Commerce & Industries (C&I) Minister Dr R Lalthangliana on Saturday (26th February, 2022) inaugurated Agri-Marketing & Training Infrastructure Building at Electric Veng, Lunglei. The Rs. 1082.93 lakhs project is implemented under the NABARD, RIDF XXIII. Lunglei HPC Vice Chairman Pu Lawmawma Tochhawng was the guest of honour at the inauguration. At the inaugural function chaired by Commerce & Industries Department Commissioner & Secretary, Pi Esther Lal Ruatkimi, Commerce & Industries (C&I) Minister Dr R Lalthangliana commended C&I Department staff, Electric veng YMA, VCs for their contribution towards successful completion of the project. As per Technical Report presented by AIE Constructions, Tuikhuahtlang, Aizawl, the 5 floors Agri-Marketing & Training Infrastructure Building has a plinth area of 574.875 Square metres. The first floor is intended to be used as a training and awareness centre for agriculture marketing with an estimated capacity of 300 people, with guest rooms, conference/meeting rooms at the Ground floor. Basement I and Basement II contain the market areas and market offices, with a parking area at the basement.
reference: COMMERCE & INDUSTRIES MINISTER-IN LUNGLEIAH AGRI-MARKETING & TRAINING INFRASTRUCTURE BUILDING HAWNG No.4122/2021-2022 Aizawl, the 26 th February 2022 : Commerce & Industries (C&I) Minister Dr R Lalthangliana chuan vawiin khan Electric Veng, Lungleiah NABARD sum cheng nuai 1082.93 senga ruahman Agri-Marketing & Training Infrastructure Building a hawng. Hawnna inkhawm Commerce & Industries Department Commissioner & Secretary, Pi Esther Lal Ruatkimi kaihhruaiah Dr R Lalthangliana chuan Lunglei khawpui chhunga hmasawnna ruhrel liantham, khawtlang tana chhenfakawm tak leh eizawnna kawnga tangkai taka hman theih tur Agri-Marketing & Training Infrastructure Building zawhfel a ni chu lawmawm tiin a buaipuitu Commerce & Industries thawktute, building sa tu te leh Electric Veng Lunglei khawtlang te chungah lawmthu a sawi a. C&I Department hnuaiah hmalakna hrang hrang kalpui mek zel anih thu sawiin Lunglei Supermarket sakna tur cheng nuai 1400 NEC atanga sanction hmuh anih thu sawiin Bangladesh ram nena kan insumdawn tawnna atana ruahman Integrated Check Post (ICP), Kawrpuichhuah, Tlabung ti hlawhtling turin Department chuan theihtawp a chhuah mek zel thu a sawi a ni. A Department chan dangte hnuaia hmalaknte pawh sawilangin Minister chuan MZU Southern Campus atan DPR cheng vaibelchhe 400 sawrkar laipuiah thehluh tawh niin chak taka bawhzui mek a ni a, MZU Southern Campus tana hman lailawk tur Engineering College building chei that hna pawh thawh mek a ni, a ti a. Civil Hospital Lungleia Trauma Centre sak pawh zawh fel thuai beisei anih thu sawiin Multipurpose Laboratory Building, NEC sum cheng nuai 300 a ruahman mek pawh nakum kum tir lama zawhfel beisei anih thu a sawi. Lunglei Municipal Council (LMC) chungchang pawh sawiin Minister chuan Municipal body chak tak enkawlna hnuaiah Lunglei khawpui chuan kawng hrang hrangin hmasawnna a nei dawn a ni, a ti. He huna khualzahawm Lunglei HPC Vice Chairman Pu Lawmawma Tochhawng chuan Agri-Marketing & Training Infrastructure Building hawn theiha peih fel a ni ta chu Pathian malsawmna ropui tak a ni tiin he hmasawnna ruhrel neih theihna tura sulsutute thawhrimna leh thahnemngaihna rah a ni, a ti a. He building ti hlawhtling tura bultan tu Pu Joseph Lalhimpuia chungah leh a hmun phal taka petu Electric Veng YMA te chungah lawmthu a sawi a ni. He building sak enkawltu AIE Constructions, Tuikhuahtlang, Aizawl atangin Technical Report ngaihtlak a ni a. Agri-Marketing & Training Infrastructure hi NABARD, RIDF XXIII hnuaia project niin total project cost hi Rs. 1082.93 lakhs ani a. Hna hi 05/10/2018 ah thawh tan a ni. A building plinth area hi 574.875 Square metres niin building hi floor nga (5) a sak a ni a. First floor hi Agriculture leh marketing lama training leh awareness centre atan ruahman niin mihring 300 vel leng tura hisap a ni. Ground floor ah hian guest room, conference/meeting room te awmin Basement I ah hian mi 78 lenna market area bakah market office ruamhan niin Basement II ah mi 85 lenna market area niin Basement III hi motor 25 lenna parking area-a ruahman a ni. No.612/2020-2021 Aizawl, 15th March,2021 : Mizoram Rajya Sabha M.P K.Vanlalvena called on Shri Venkaiah Naidu, Chairman, Rajya Sabha and Vice President of India today at his official residence and calls for the central governmentâ€™s intervention for restoration of peace in the trouble torn Myanmar, and to provide relief measures for Myanmar nationals who crossed international border to take shelter in Mizoram following gross atrocities committed against protesters who stand up for democracy, human rights and justice since the military junta took control of the Myanmar government. During his meeting with the Vice President, Vanlalvena was accompanied by MNF party Adviser Rosangzuala. Both raised their concern that situation in Myanmar could go from bad to worse. source: MIZORAM CHIEF SECRETARY LEADS GOVERNMENT EMPLOYEES IN TAKING INTEGRITY PLEDGE 275/2023-2024 Vigilance Awareness Week, 2023 is to be observed in the whole of India from today, i.e. 30th October till 5th November, 2023. This year the theme is - 'Say no to corruption, commit to the Nation'. Starting off the Vigilance Week in Mizoram too, Chief Secretary Dr. Renu Sharma led the officials and staff of the Mizoram Secretariat, MINECO this morning in taking the 'Integrity Pledge' in the Secretariat Courtyard. Likewise, all Heads of Offices under the State Government also led the employees in their respective offices in taking the Integrity Pledge, in which each government servant avowed to follow probity and rule of law in all walks of life, to neither take nor offer bribe, to perform all tasks in an honest and transparent manner, to act in public interest, to lead by example exhibiting integrity in personal behavior and to report any incident of corruption to the appropriate agency. source: HEALTH MINISTER DR. R. LALTHANGLIANA FLAGGED OFF 11 MOBILE MEDICAL VAN IN MAMIT DISTRICT No.541/2020-2021 Dr. R. Lalthangliana Health Minister flagged off 11 Bolero Campers designed for Mobile medical van to be used in rural areas of Mamit Aspiration District. Health Minister specially thank REC Ltd for their selfless help through their CSR initiatives in fostering aspiring district like Mamit which would help them aspire i in various development fields. Bolero Camper (4WD BS6) 11 nos were bought for - Rs. 1,04,50,000/- under REC Ltd. CSR initiative as reported by Nodal Officer Beitlotha Nohro. Also Laptop & Speaker consisting of 52 nunbers worth Rs. 24,60,000/- was also handed over by the minister to CMO and DMS Mamit District hospital. Essential Drugs & Diagnostic kits 76 nos - worth Rs.15,60,000/- and Folic Acid, Oral rehydration salt, Ibuprofen, Ascorbic Acid (vitamin C), Albendazole, Paracetamol and other Diagnostic Kits of 50 nos and Sahli's Haemoglobinometer, Pregnancy Test Kit, Malaria Test Kit, Typhoid Test Kit, BP Instrument Mercurial, Adult Weighing Machine, Hepatitis B-Test Kit etc were given out in the same programme. Er. H. Lalzirliana, Mamit A/C MLA, Pu C. Lalrammawia, Chairman ZOHANCO, Health Department Officials and NGOs and Village Council leaders were present at the programme. The Flagged off programme was chaired by the DC Mamit himself Dr. Lalrozama IAS. Attachment Loading attachment...
reference: HEALTH MINISTER-IN MAMIT DISTRICT CHHUNGA HMAN TUR MOBILE MEDICAL VAN LEH HMANRAW DANGTE VAILIAM No.7589/2020-2021 Vawiin khan Dr. R. Lalthangliana, Minister, Health & Family Welfare Department, Higher & Technical Education, Commerce & Industries chuan Mobile Medical Van, Essential Drugs & Diagnostic Kits & Laptops and Speaker Mamit District Hospital, PHC/CHC leh Sub- Centre-a hman tur vailiam. Khuallian Dr. R Lalthangliana chuan Mamit District chhunga cheng te'n hriselna kawnga hma an sawn theihna tura hmanraw tangkai tak taka thuam an ni chu a lawmawm thusawiin District - 11 zinga Medical Doctor ngei District Bawrhsap, hriselna kawnga a ngaihna hria in nei chu in vannei takzet a. Aspirational District atangin Mizoram District 11- te zingah pakhatna ni thei tura tan la tura chahin in tum tlat chuan theihloh a awm lo a ni tiin kum zabi 21-a hmasawnna chu hmang tangkaiin dik taka kan hmachhawn chuan District hnufual ber thin kha a ropui ber kan ni thei a ni a ti. Dr. Thangtea chuan Pathian ringtu mizo nih hi a nuama, pi leh pute atanga lungrual tak leh inpumkhatna nena thawkho thin kan nihna chuan rah tha chhuah zelin, Covid - 19 avanga nunna chan kan nei erawh pawi hle rualin hri dona kawnga kan hmalakna-a hlawhtlinna kan hmuh mekte leh India hmarchhak State pariat (8) zingah Covid - 19 vanga thi tlemna ber State kan ni chu Pathian avang leh kan thawhhona avang a ni a ti. Minister chuan hmasawnna kan hmuh mekte chu chho zawnga thlira in delhbeh tir mai lovin hmasawnna tluantling nei turin kan tih ve theih tawk theuha tan la thar turin kalkhawmte a fuih a. Kawngpui tha nei turin hmalakna kalpui mek niin khawchhak lam atanga khawthlang lam hawiin kawngsial hna thawh tan mek a nih thu a sawi bawk. Er. H. Lalzirliana, Bialtu MLA pawhin Mamit District-in hriselna kawnga hma kan sawn theihna tur leh Aspirational District kan nihna atanga khaichhuah kan nihna tura CSR hnuai atanga hmanraw tangkai tak tak lei a ni chu lawmawm a tih thusawiin Kan District Bawrhsap-in hemi kawnga hma a lakna chu fakawm a tih thu a sawi a. Covid-19 hripuiin khawvel a tih buai mek karah Mizoram chu Sorkar hmalakna chak tak a vang te, Kohhran mite tawngtaina vang te leh khawtlang hruaitute hmalakna avangin India ram state zingah a titha ber pawl kan ni chu lawmawm a tih thu a sawi bawk. Bialtu MLA chuan Mamit District-in kawngpui tha kan neih chu Mizoram Sawrkarin a ngaihpawimawh berte zing a mi a nih avangin chak taka hmalakna kalpui a ni a, hun reilote-ah kawngpui tha kan nei thuai a beisei thu a sawi. Mamit District-in hriselna lama hma kan sawna, nu naupai te'n enkawlna tha zawk an dawn a, damdawi an mamawh angte an hmuh theihna tur bakah damlote enkawlna tha zawk leh rang zawk pek an nih theihna tura District chhung PHC/CHC leh Health Sub- Centre-te tana hmanraw lei hi Mamit District Bawrhsap hmalakna-in REC LTD, CSR Health Project hnuai atanga lei a ni. Vawiin-a sem tak Bolero Camper(4WD BS6) 11 lei nan hian Rs. 1,04,50,000/- hman niin Motor-te hi Health Care delivery a bik takin vaccination drive, Health camp conduct leh awareness pekna tur bakah, kawng that lohna hmun, motor naran in a thlen theih lohna khuate awlsam taka thlen theihnan 4 wheeled drive lei a ni a. source: HEALTH MINISTER INAUGURATES 43RD ANNUAL CONFERENCE OF IMA, MIZORAM STATE BRANCH The Indian Medical Association (IMA), Mizoram State Branch observed its 43rd annual conference today at Aijal Club where the Minister for Health and Family Welfare Department Dr.R.Lalthangliana was the Chief Guest. The theme of this yearâ€™s conference is â€œEnding the HIV&AIDS Epidemic: Community by Communityâ€. Speaking at the inaugural function, the Minister said that the government is committed to advance public health efforts and improve health for all. He encouraged the medical community to revive their efforts and recommit themselves in serving the public. Established in 1976, the Mizoram State Branch of IMA currently has 750 members out of which 33 are newly inducted. The Mizoram State Branch received two prestigious awards this year, namely the IMA Special Award for Organizing (IMA North East Leaders Meet Conclave) and President Appreciation Award (for IMA Membership Drive Trophy) from the IMA General Headquarters. The IMA is a voluntary organization where all doctors, whether employed by the government or practising in private, are registered members. The organization looks after the interest of doctors as well as the well being of the community at large. It aims to promote medical and its allied sciences, improve public health and maintain honour and dignity of the medical profession.

source: Did Paul disclose all his revelations? Far from it. He wrote, “I know a man [who is himself] in Christ, fourteen years ago (whether in the body I do not know, or outside the body I do not know; God knows) such a one was caught away to the third heaven” (v. 2). He did not divulge this experience until fourteen years later. What depth there was in Paul! It would be a wonder if we could hide away something we received from God for seven years. But for fourteen years Paul never divulged his experience; for fourteen years God’s church knew nothing of it; for fourteen years not one of the apostles had heard of it. Paul’s roots were deep beneath the soil.

source: MYC CHAIRMAN LAYS FOUNDATION STONE FOR MYC INCUBATION CENTRE AT SERKAWN, LUNGLEI No.573/2021-2022 Aizawl the 28th March, 2022 : MYC Chairman Dr Vanlaltanpuia, Lunglei North MLA laid the foundation stone for Mizoram Youth Commission Incubation Centre at Serkawn,Lunglei near Lena Stadium on Saturday (26th March, 2022). The land for the Incubation Centre was donated by Serkawn VC. Lunglei High Powered Committee Vice Chairman Pu Lawmawma Tochhawng, Pu H. Lalnunzuala, Under Secretary MYC, Pu Lalrotluanga, President YMA Sub-Headquarters Lunglei and representatives from Serkawn locality and various NGOs were also present at the occasion. On the occasion of this foundation stone laying ceremony, MYC Chairman Dr Vanlaltanpuia said this centre would cater to the needs of aspiring Mizo youths such as competitive coaching, Information Technology, skill development and entrepreneurship. He thanked the local leaders of Serkawn who donated the property to MYC, and promised them that the centre would be used for the betterment of society and the economy. Talking about the MYC Coaching Centres in Lunglei, Siaha, Kolasib Districts and the one in Champhai which will be opened shortly, the MYC Chairman said that he along with the MYC team would continue working in earnest for the advancement of Mizo youths to the best of their capabilities. He stated that construction of MYC Youth Centres are underway at Aizawl,Serchhip and Lunglei. In addition to competitive exams, MYC is planning to continue to provide cement mistiri training, food processing training, cake baking training, cabin crew, Army Pre-Recruitment training and promotion of music and sports to help the youths reach their goals at the national level. The MYC Chairman said that the MYC Super IAS 20 which was started in 2020 will be upgraded to Super IAS 40 which will comprise of 20 more aspirants. He further said that the road connecting Khawiva, Aizawl-Thenzawl-Lunglei road and roads in Lunglei town will be repaired and that the budget for the improvement works for MZU Southern Campus is raised to Rs.15 crore. Lunglei High Powered Committee Vice Chairman Pu Lawmawma Tochhawng shared that although the staff of MYC are few in number, their contributions to the future of Mizo youths are commendable. He stated his appreciation for the Incubation Centre and urged the people to make the most out of this centre. Pu Lalrotluanga, President YMA Sub-Headquarters Lunglei and Pu K. Zodinsanga, VCP Serkawn also gave a brief speech, Pu Lalmuanzuala, CC, MYC Lunglei ended the ceremony with vote of thanks speech. Attachment Loading attachment...

MYC Incubation Centre hmun tur hi Lena Stadium bulah awmin a ram hi Serkawn VC te pek a ni. He hunah hian Lunglei High Powered Committee Vice Chairman Pu Lawmawma Tochhawng, Pu H. Lalnunzuala, Under Secretary MYC, Pu Lalrotluanga, President YMA Sub Hqrs Lunglei leh Serkawn khawtlang hruaitute leh tlawmngai pawl hrang hrang aiawhte an tel a ni. Mizoram Youth Commission Chairman Dr Vanlaltanpuia chuan MYC Incubation Centre-ah hian thalaite hmasawnna tura hmalakna hrang hrang â€“ competitive coaching, Information Technology, skill development leh entrepreneurship-te a len vek tur thu sawiin residential tura ruahman a nih thu a sawi a. Thalaite hmakhua ngaia an ram phal taka pe tu Serkawn khawtlang te chungah lawmthu sawiin an ram pek chu kan human resource tih hmasawnna kawngah leh kan ram economy than len zelna kawngah tangkai taka hman anih tur thu a sawi. A sawi zel naah MYC Chairman chuan Mizo thalaite hmasawnna turin MYC chuan theihtawp a chhuah zel dawn a ni tiin Lunglei, Siaha leh Kolasib District -ah te MYC Coaching Centre hawn tawh niin Champhai ah pawh hawn leh thuai tum a ni a. Aizawl leh Serchhip ah MYC Youth Centre sak mek niin, Lunglei ah MYC Youth Centre sak mek pawh zawhfel tep a nih thu a sawi. Mizo thalaite hawizau zela, National level chona va man phak ve tura kawng kawhhmuh zel MYC chuan a tum thu sawiin competitive exam coaching mai bakah cement mistiri training, food processing training, cake baking training, cabin crew, Army Pre-Recruitment training, music leh sports lamah te hmalakna kal mekin heng hmalaknte hi zau zawka kalpui zel tum anih thu a sawi. Kum 2020 atanga kalpui MYC Super IAS 20 chungchang pawh sawilangin MYC Chairman chuan heng zirlai thlanchhuah 20 te hi MYC sponsor in Delhi ah thla thum (February â€“ March 2021) coaching zuk kalin MYC nena agreement an neih ang ngei in UPSC Preliminary Exam 2021 chu an zavaiin an ziak veka. Agreement-ah hian MYC Super IAS 20 te hian UPSC 2021 an tlin loh chuan kum thum dang (2022-2024) preliminary exam an bei leh tura tih niin hemi karah hian state level competitive exam emaw exam dang an ziah phalsak an ni a. Heng exam te an ziah avang hian kan agreement an bawhchhe lo a ni, a ti a. Super IAS hi zau zawka kalpui tum niin Super IAS 40 kalpui turin budget ah cheng vaibelchhe 2 dah fel tawh a nih thu sawiin chhimlam District zirlaite lo ngaihven ve ngei turin a chah a ni. Hemi bakah hian Khawiva panna kawng, Aizawl-Thenzawl-Lunglei kawng leh Lunglei khawpui chhung kawng te siam that tur anih thu sawiin MZU Southern Campus tura ruahman chei that hna pawh tluang taka kalin a budget hi cheng vaibelchhe 15 ah tihpun anih thu a sawi bawk. Lunglei High Powered Committee Vice Chairman Pu Lawmawma Tochhawng pawhin thu sawiin MYC hnuaiah thawktu staff tlemte chauh awm mahse Mizo thalaite tana an hmalakna hi a hlu in a chhuanawm takzet a ni, a ti a. Lunglei khawpui ah zirna in changtlung tak Incubation Centre kan nei tur chu kan vannei takzet a, mipuiten kan hlut a kan hman tangkai thiam a tul dawn a ni tiin Lunglei District thalaite chu tun aia hawizau tur leh tih tak takna nena hma la turin a sawm a ni. Vawiin program-ah hian Pu Lalrotluanga, President YMA Sub Hqrs Lunglei leh Pu K. Zodinsanga, VCP Serkawn te pawhin thu sawiin Pu Lalmuanzuala, CC, MYC Lunglei in lawmthu sawina hun a hmang a ni. source: SPORTS MINISTER LAUDS MIZORAM GIRLSâ€™ VICTORY IN NES U-19 FOOTBALL CHAMPIONSHIP Headquarters 23 Sector Assam Rifles today organised a felicitation programme at Loch Hall within the precincts of 46 Assam Rifles, Aizawl for team members of the Mizoram U-19 Girls Team who recently lifted the Assam Rifles organized North East States Under-19 Championship held during July 17-21 at Diphu and Kohima. Sports Minister Shri Robert Romawia Royte presided over the function and lauded the efforts of the team members and the support provided by the Assam Rifles. Speaking on the occasion, the Minister highlighted the role football has played in connecting the North Eastern states with the rest of the country and said that it is an important tool in strengthening national integration and in helping the region mainstream with the rest of the country. Appreciating the cooperation between the Mizoram Government and Mizoram Football Association (MFA) in furthering the cause of football, the Minister expressed hope that this partnership will grow stronger and reach new heights in the coming days. He said that the Government will support MFA and other sports organizations and associations in all the possible way whether through financial assistance or otherwise. He pointed that for the first time ever Mizoram will soon have a comprehensive sports policy â€˜Mizoram Sports Policyâ€™ and through this policy Mizoram will achieve accolades in sports, he added. The Minister also spelt out new initiatives in the pipeline for development of football in the state and said that Flood Lighting and other works of Rajiv Gandhi Stadium to meet international standards will soon be completed. source: Governor Hari Babu Kambhampati visits Sainik School Chhingchhip 191/2022-2023 Chhingchhip, the 30th September 2022: Governor Hari Babu Kambhampati who is on an official tour of Serchhip District visited Sainik School, Chhingchhip, a few miles away from Serchhip town today. Upon his arrival, Governor was accorded the Guard of Honour by 8 Bn of Assam Rifles. He was then introduced to the staff by Wcdr Shahul Hameed, Principal, and Maj S.Kalyan, Administrative Officer. A briefing about the School to Governor was given by the Principal in his office room. After this, an official function with a cultural program was organized inside the Assembly Hall in honour of the esteemed visitor. Here, the Governor addressed the students. Governor Hari Babu Kambhampati congratulated faculties for their best effort to keep up with other establishwd Sainik Schools in the country. He thanked the state government for bring up a highly valuable asset of national importance in education like Sainik school here in Mizoram. He expressed his pride of having the first Sainik School in the country where girl students are admitted. He stressed the importance of Sainik Schools for preparing the young students to become cadet officers in Army, Airforces and Navy. Beside this, he said the school also prepared the students to become role model students and role model citizen. He reminded the students of the school about their important duties for the national integration of the county. Full speech of the Honble Governor : https://dipr.mizoram.gov.in/post/speech-of-dr-hari-babu-kambhampati-honble-governor-of-mizoram-on-the-occasion-of-visit-to-sainik-school-chhingchhip-on-30th-september-2022 The programme began with welcome address by Maj S.Kalyan, Admn and concluded with vote of thanks proposed by WCdr Shahul Hameed, Principal, Sainik School, Chhingchhip. After the official programme, Governor inspected the facilities inside the campus of Sainik School Chhingchhip. As per the briefing by the Principal, here are the few highlights of the school. The school is now 6 years old and running with the pilot cadets in Class XI. The annual intake of students are 60 boys and 10 girls in the class VI while in the class IX only boys are admitted with the availability of 10 seats for students annually. The annual fee per a student is estimated at Rs 1.85 lakh per year. The schools have daily routine for winter and summer and winter with the physical and classroom activities through out the day. It usually starts from very early morning till 9:00 to 9:30 PM at night. Apart from the facilities for cocurricular activities, the School is also currently having the facilities like Football Ground, Badminton Court, Basketball Court, Gynasium, Music room,etc.,. The swimming pool, parade ground and other big sports facilities are being planned to be added very soon. The Principal highlighted the status of Grant in Aid from the state, issues with water and power bills, LMV ambulance to be received from the Mizoram Rural Bank through CSR, INSAS rifles to be received from Home Department, Government of Mizoram, Infrastructural Fund received to the tune of Rs 99,96,000 the Ministry of Defence with the proposed implementations. To solve the issue with high power bills, the Governor advised implementation of Solar Power Generation plant inside the campus. While, the issue with high water bills is being taken up the office Deputy Commissioner and is expected to be solved very soon. Governor in his visit to Sainik School, Chhingchhip was escorted and given a company by Pu Lalmuansanga Ralte, Addl DC and Pu Stephen Lalrinawma, SP, Serchhip District. reference: Governor Hari Babu Kambhampati in Sainik School Chhingchhip a tlawh 2122/2022-2023 Chhingchhip, the 30th September 2022: Governor Hari Babu Kambhampati chuan vawiin khan Sainik School Chhingchhip a tlawh a. He hunah hian School building leh hmunhma te a endik a, Sikul naupangte hmaah fuihna thu a sawi bawk a ni. Governor hian Sainik School a thlenin amah zahna chibai 8 Bn Assam Rifles ten School kawtah an lo buk a. Wcdr Shahul Hameed, Principal leh Maj S.Kalyan, Administrative Officer ten zirtirtute leh School staff te an hmelhriattir chhunzawm a. Hemi zawh hian Principal Office ah Sainik School dinhmunte inhrilhhriatna hun neih leh a ni a. Assembly Hall-ah Official programme leh Cultural Programme neih chhunzawm nghal a ni. Governor Hari Babu Kambhampati chuan Principal leh a thawhpui ten Sainik School tha tak ni tur leh hmun danga Sainik School te dinhmun pha tura theihtawp an chhuah chu fakawm a tih thu a sawi hmasa a. Mizoram sawrkarin hetiang ang School tha bik Mizorama zirlaite tan a buatsaih thei chu lawmawm a tih thu a sawi bawk a ni. Sainik School Chhingchhip hi India ram hmundang te aia a danglam bik na chu helai hmunah hian Sainik School dangte entawn turin a vawikhatna atana leh a hmahruaitu ni turin hmeichhe naupangte luh tir an ni a. Hei hi a chhuanawm tak zet a ni a ti. Sainik School te hi khawi hmunah pawh School thabik an ni a, Sipai, Navy leh Airforce Officer ni turin a bik takin heng schoolah te hian zirlai te zirtirna pek a ni a ti. Sainik School a zirlaite hi Armed Forces ah an thawkvek kher lo a nih pawhin khawtlang leh ram tana khua leh tui entawn tlak ni tura chher an nih thu a sawi bawk. India chakna chu danglamna tam tak kara inpumkhatna leh inunauna tha a ni tih zirlaite chu a hrilh nawn leh a. He mawhphurhna huangah hian Sainik School zirlaite chu hmahruaitu ni turin a chah a ni. Hemi hnu hian Assembly Hall chhunga programme hi tan a ni a. Zirlai ten Governor pualin Cultural programme an hmang a. WCdr Shahul Hameed, Principal, Sainik School, Chhingchhip chuan lawmthu sawiin huntawp a khar a ni. Official programme zawh hian Saini School Campus chhunga School building leh hmunhma te Governor chuan a endik chhunzawm nghal a ni. Principal Report atanga a lan dan chuan Sainik School Chhingchhip hi kum 6 hmel a hmu mek a. Tunah hian batch hmasa ber(Class VI) te chu Class XI an ni mek a ni. Sainik School a lut tur hian All India Entrance Test paltlang a ngai a. Sikul naupang pakhat tana kum khat chhunga senso chu Rs 1.85 lakh velah chhut a ni. Kumtin Class VI ah hian mipa naupang 60 leh Hmeichhe naupang 10 admission pek an ni mek a. Class IX ah erawh chuan mipa chiah admission pek niin kum tin seat 10 a awm thin a ni. School naupangte hian zing dar 5 vel atangin zan dar 9:30 vel thleng nitin, lehkha zirna hun, infiamna leh thildang tangkai zir nan hun an hmang thin a. Lehkha zirna leh a kaihhnaih(cocurricular activities) bakah zirlaite tan hian taksa insawizawina leh themthiamna chidangte ( extracurricular activities) atana hmunhma pawimawh Football Ground, Badminton Court, Basketball Court, Gynasium, Music room,etc., te he school hian a nei a. Swimming pool, parade ground leh sports facility tangkai tak tak buatsaih chhoh zel a tum bawk. Principal hian Mizoram sawrkar in tanpuina a pek thin - GIA dinhmun te, Ambulance te chi MRB in CSR kaltlanga pek a tum chungchang te, NCC te tana tangkai INSAS silai Home Department, Govt of Mizoram in pek a tum chunchang te Rs 99,96,000 school tihphuisuina atana Ministry of Defence atang sum lo kal tur chungchangte a sawi a. An harsatna pahnih Tui Bill sang tak leh Electric chhit man sang lutuk chungchangte pawh sawi a ni. Kawlphetha a harsatna sutkian a nih theih nan campus chhunga Solar Power Generation Plant bun turin Governor chuan Sainik School Chhingchhip hotute chu thurawn a pe a. Tui bill chungchang pawh Serchhip DC office leh PHED ten chinfel sak turin hma an la mek tih sawi a ni. source: ASSAM RIFLES BATTALION TO CONDUCT 8TH ROZGAR MELA FOR MIZORAM STATE 195/2023-2024 Aizawl the 26th August, 2023 - Battalion of Headquarters Inspector General Assam Rifles (East) will be conducting 8th Rozgar Mela on 28 August 2023 at 2 AR Gajraj Hall, Lakhimpur Battalion. A large number of individuals will be benefitted by the Mela. Central Government is set to organize the 8th Job Fair on 28 August 2023. This event, spanning over 25 states and more than 44 locations, will see the distribution of appointment letters to approximately 70,000 young individuals of various Departments of the Indian Government. Notably, our Honorable Prime Minister Narendra Modi will preside over the event, addressing the youth through live streaming, followed by the distribution of appointment letter to the candidates present. Assam Rifles is playing a pivotal role in organizing the Rozgar Mela for the state of Mizoram and overseeing the eventâ€™s coordination. The Honorable Minister of Minority Affairs, Mr John Barla will personally hand over appointment letter to the candidates. The Honorable Prime Minister will witness the ceremony via Video Conferencing. The Rozgar Mela is a step towards fulfillment of the duty of Government to accord highest priority to employment generation.
reference: ASSAM RIFLES BATTALION-IN ROZGAR MELA BUATSAIH DAWN 1663/2023-2024 Aizawl, the 26th August, 2023: Headquarters Inspector General Assam Rifles (East) hnuaia Assam Rifles Battalion chuan August ni 28, 2023 hian Rozgar Mela/Job Fair tum 8-na 2 AR Gajraj Hall, Lakhimpur Battalion, Aizawl-ah a buatsaih dawn. Sawrkar laipui ruahmannain Rozgar Mela/Job Fair chu August ni 28, Thawhtanni hian State hrang hrang 25 a hmun 44 ahte huaihawt a ni dawn a. He hunah hian Indian Government hnuai Department hrang hranga hna hmu thar mi 70,000 dawnte hnenah appointment letter pek chhuah a ni ang. Prime Minister Pu Narendra Modi chuan ram pum huap hun hman hi a kaihruai dawn a, live streaming kaltlangin thalaite hnena thuchah a sawi hnuah hna hmu thar a hmuna awmte hnenah appointment letter a sem chhuak dawn a ni. Mizorama Rozgar Mela/Job Fair hlawhtling taka huaihawt a nih theih nan Assam Rifles chuan hma a la a, he hun hi Sawrkar laipuia Minister of State for Minority Affairs Pu John Barla chuan a hmanpui dawn a, hna hmu tharte kutah appointment letter a hlan dawn a ni. Ram chhung hmun hrang hranga hun hmante hi Prime Minister chuan Video Conferencing kaltlangin a chhim dawn a ni. Rozgar Mela hi Sawrkar laipuiin hna neilote tana hna a siam sakna kawnga hmalakna ngaih pawimawh tak a ni.

source:
A. As the Indwelling Spirit
God puts His Spirit in us so that His Spirit may be the indwellingSpiritwithinus,thatwemayknowGodandexpe- rience all that God in Christ has accomplished for us (Rom. 8:9-11). This is the special blessing given by God in the New Testament era; it did not exist in the Old Testament. In the OldTestament,GodonlycausedHisSpirittocomefromwith- out to work upon man; He did not cause His Spirit to dwell withinman. Only after the Lord’s death and resurrection did God give His Spirit to us and cause His Spirit to dwell in us as the indwelling Spirit (John 14:16-17). Thus, He is able to reveal both God and Christ to us from within,that we in Christ may receive and enjoy the fullness of God (Col. 2:9-10).

A. Chhûnglama Chenchilhtu Thlarau Angin
Pathianin kan chhûngah a thlarau a dah a, tichuan a thlarau chu kan chhûngah chenchilhtu Thlarau a ni ang a, Pathian hriatna leh Pathian lama Krista-in kan tâna a hlenchhuah zawng zawng tawnhriatna kan nei thei dawn a ni (Rom 8:9-11). Hei hi Thuthlung Thar huna malsawmna danglam bik Pathianin a pêk chu a ni a; Thuthlung Hluiah a awm rêng rêng lo a ni. Thuthlung Hluiah chuan Pathian chuan a Thlarau chu pawnlama mihring chunga hnathawk tur ringawtin a siam a, mihring chhûngah chuan a Thlarau chu chenchilh turin a siam lo a ni. Lalpa thihna leh thawhlehna hnuah chauh chuan Pathian chuan a Thlarau chu kan hnenah min pe in, chenchilhtu Thlarau angin Thlarau chu kan chhûnga nung turin a siam a (John. 14:16-17). Hei vâng hian kan chhûnglam aṭangin Pathian leh Krista chu a puangchhuak thei a, tichuan Pathian khahna chu keini Krista ami ten kan lo dawn a kan chen theihna turin a ni (Kol. 2:9-10).
hypothesis: (Rom 8:9-11) Hei hi Thuthlung Hlui-a Pathianin malsawmna bik a pêk chu a ni a, Thuthlung Hlui-ah a awm lo a ni. Thuthlung Hlui-ah chuan Pathianin a Thlarau chu mihring chungah a thawk chhuak a; mihring chhûngah a Thlarau chu a awmtîr lo a ni. Lalpa thih leh thawhleh hnuah chauh Pathianin a Thlarau chu min pe a, Thlarau chu kan chhûngah a awmtîr a ni (Johana 14:16-17). Chuvângin, Pathian leh Krista chu kan chhûngah min hriattîr thei a ni, Kristaah chuan Pathian famkimna kan dawn theih nân (Kolossa 2:9-10).

source: CHIEF MINISTER ATTENDED GRADUATION AND LAMP LIGHTING CEREMONY AT RIPANS Chief Minister Pu Zoramthanga attended the Lamp Lighting & Graduation Ceremony at Regional Institute of Paramedical and Nursing Sciences(RIPANS), Aizawl as chief guest yesterday. Speaking on the occassion, the Chief Minister offered his congratulations to the graduates, wishing them success in their future careers. He also encouraged the new B.Sc Nursing students to be diligent in their studies to become exceptional healthcare professionals, which is one of the most noble profession. Speaking of how the government takes various measures to ensure examplary healthcare system, the Chief Minister said that public support is needed for success. In yesterday's function the Chief Minister gave away Proficiency Award to toppers of all departments in the institute. This year saw 180 graduates from RIPANS with 36 B.Sc. Nursing, 40 B.Sc. MLT (Medical Laboratory Technology), 23 B. Pharm, 34 B. Optometry, 31 B.Sc. RIT (Radio Imaging Technology) and 16 M. Pharm. Dr. Chawngthanliana, Director, RIPANS handed out Certificate of Appreciation to the new Graduates and Post Graduates. 35 students of B.Sc Nuring were newly inducted through the Lamp Lighting Ceremony with Pi Lalrinthangi, Nursing Superintendent, Civil Hospital Aizawl as lamp lighter. RIPANS was set up by the Ministry of Home Affairs in 1995-96 under North Eastern Council (NEC). Then it was transferred to the Ministry of Health & Family Welfare on April, 2007. As of 2019, 2820 students have graduated from RIPANS since it's inception in 1996. Presently, there are 655 students enrolled in the six departments the institution offers. With the recommendation of the Meeting of Executive Council of the Institute under the Ministry earlier this year which approved Rs. 480.12 cr. for Upgradation and Development of RIPANS, plans to open seven more departments. Apart from this, creation of 154 posts including that of medical doctors, nurses and other paramedics, and infrastructural developments including hospitals, academic building, sports complex, hostel and quarters are underway. source: Governor Hari Babu Kambhampati visits Champhai Tlangsam Winery 326/2022-2023 Aizawl, the 1st February 2023 : Governor Hari Babu Kambhampati, who is on a two-day tour of Champhai District visited the Tlangsam Winery on the outskirt of Champhai Town this evening. At the site, Governor Hari Babu Kambhampati was given an escorted tour to various units by the managing officers of the winery. Thereafter, a short program was held at B Remmawia Packing hall, Champhai Winery. Governor Hari Babu expressed his delight in visiting the factory started, owned, and managed by a society of farmers. He was particularly appreciative of having witness the production centre where the determined farmers themselves added value to their products. He congratulated the Champhai Grape Growers Society and the Hnahlan Grape Growers and Processing Co-operative Society Ltd. Governor welcomed the ambitious proposal to upgrade these wineries at Champhai and Hnahlan to accomodate the growing production of the Grapes in these areas. He extended his support for this proposal and if necessary, he agreed to discuss the matter with the authorities in the Ministry of Food Processing Industries(MoFPI). On behalf of Champhai Winery, Pu Hrilchunglura, General Manager, Champhai Grape Growers Society(GGGS) gave a report. The Winery was started in 2007. After 14 years of existence with the production actually started in 2010 the Winery has now grown. At present the society has 134 members. The fruit is of Bangalore Blue variety. During last year the Winery bought 1144.98 qts of grapes. As the grape production increases, CGGS submitted two projects - one project to MoFPI and another project to state department under Pradhan Mantri Jan Vikas Karyakram (PMJVK). Hemi hnu hian Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana (PMUY) leh Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Housing for All (Urban) hnuaia hamthatna dawngtute tlawhin a kawm a ni. Governor hi Environment, Forest & Climate Change Minister Pu T.J. Lalnuntluanga, Champhai South bialtu MLA ni bawk bakah DC Champhai Pu James Lalrinchhana, SP Pu Lalrinpuia Varte leh Official dangten an tawiawm a ni. Governor Pu Hari Babu Kambhampati chuan Champhai Winery tlawh theia a awm chu lawmawm a tih thu sawiin, an hmalaknate engemawchen a lo hriat tawh thu a sawi a. Champhai District-a Winery pahnih lai a awm leh loneitute intelkhawmin an kalpui chu ropui a tih thu a sawi a. Grape chingtuten harsatna an tawh chu pawi a tih thu sawiin, Sawrkarin dan thar siama hma a la chu lawmawm a ti a. Wine siam chu food processing hnuaia a awm anih thu sawiin, agriculture product-te cheibawla siam danglam value addition chu hmalakna pawimawh tak a ni, a ti a. Tun aia nasaa huang zauh leh changtlung zawka kal tura Ministry of Food Processing Industries kaltlanga hmalakna an nei chu lawmawm a tih thu a sawi bawk. Governor chuan Grape chauh nilo thei dang sawr leh um theihte pawh ngaihvena huang zauh a tul thu a sawi a. An hmalak lehzelna turah duhsakna a hlan a, Mizoram mai nilo India rama loneitute tana entawntlak leh tihhmuhtu nih tum turin a chah a ni. Environment, Forest & Climate Change Minister Pu T.J. Lalnuntluanga chuan Champhai District chhunga loneitute hmalakna pawimawh tak grape sawngbawlna hmunhma Governor-in a hun hlu tak senga a tlawh chu lawmawm a ti a. Hun harsa tak paltlanga dan anga grape zawrhna tur dan thar Sawrkarin a siam thu sawiin, grape chingtuten hmabak eng tak an neih thu sawiin duhsakna a hlan a. Tun aia nasa zawka hma la a, ram ngaw humhalh nan kum tina lovah thin bansana lo nghet nei thei tura ngaihtuahna seng turin a chah a. Tun atanga reiloteah Sapthei sawngbawlna turte pawh buaipui tum anih thu sawiin, harsatna an neihte a hnena thlen hrehlo turin a chah a ni. Inkawmhona hun Packing Hall, Champhai Winery, Tlangsama hman hi Pu HS.Vanlalfakzuala, Chairman, Champhai Grape Growers Society (CGGS) chuan a kaihruai a. Pu Hrilchunglura, General Manager hnen atangin report ngaihthlak a ni a. Hnahlan Grape Growers and Processing Co-operative Society Limited hotute atangin thusawi ngaihthlak a ni bawk. Mizoram hi North East India-a grape thar awm chhun leh India rama grape thar tam 5-na niin, Champhai leh Hnahlan-ah Winery a awm a. CGGS enkawl Champhai Winery hian kum 14 hmel a hmu tawh a, an Grape sawngbawl hi Bangalore Blue variety niin, vawiin thlengin Grape quintal ,15,218 an lei tling tawh a, hemi atan hian Rs 5,78,41,160/- (cheng vaibelchhe nga maktaduai sarih nuai riat singli sangkhat za leh sawmruk) an seng tawh a ni. Kum 2010 atang khan Grape quintal 918 leiin bul an tan a, kum kalta khan quintal 1144.98 an lei tling a, an Grape lakte hi herin a umna zemah an um mek a ni. Kum 2007 khan Champhai Grape Growers Association (CGGA) tih thin chu Winery din anih dawn avangin Champhai Grape Growers Society (CGGS) ti a thlak niin, Firms & Society-ah an inziahlut a ni. MIP sum cheng nuai 83 (loan) hmanga bultan niin, he loan hi November ni 9, 2020 khan Sawrkar chuan rulh let ngai lo turin grant-ah a leh sak a ni. Champhai Grape Growers Society-ah hian Governing Board Member 15 awmin kum 2 danah inthlan thin a ni a. Tun dinhmunah hian Champhai Grape Growers Society-ah hian Grape chingtu member 134 awm mekin, Staff leh Worker mi 30, Executive Member 9 leh Office Bearer 6 an awm mek bawk a. Champhai Grape Growers Society hnuaiah hian Branch 9 awm mekin mumal taka inenkawlna kalpui thin a ni. CGGS hian Ministry of Food Processing Industries (MOFPI) kaltlangin project an kalpui mek a. DC Office kaltlangin Pradhan Mantri Jan Vikas Karyakram (PMJVK) hnuaiah Commerce & Industries Department hnuaiah project dil mek a ni bawk a. Dan thar hnuaiah Winery License an nei fel tawh a, State pawn thlenga hralhchhuak thei turin hmachhawp an nei a ni. Champhai Winery a tlawh zawh hian Governor chuan BPL family-te tana a thlawna eirawngbawlna gas connection pekna scheme, Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana (PMUY) kaltlanga hamthatna dawngtu leh khawpuia cheng insak tanpuina scheme, Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Housing for All (Urban) dawngtu Tlangsam ami te a tlawh a; scheme awmzia leh tangkainate a sawifiah a, an hmuh dan leh chhawr tangkai dante a zawt nghal bawk. source: PU LAWMAWMA TOCHHAWNG VICE CHAIRMAN HPC INAUGURATES RENOVATED LUNGLEI POLICE STATION BUILDING 151/2023-2024 Lunglei;the 1st August,2023 : Pu Lawmawma Tochhawng, Vice Chairman, HPC Lunglei inaugurated a newly renovated Lunglei Police Station Building(Ground Floor) here in Lunglei town, today. Lunglei PS building was constructed wayback in 1991 and the building became dilapidated and worn out.Lunglei PS building is a two storey building. Lunglei High Powered Committee Funded this renovation works, at the tune of Rs.15 lakh for each storey. Rs.15 lakh was released for the year 202-2023 which was being used for renovation of Ground Floor, which was inaugurated today. Fund for 1st Floor renovation is also released for the year 2023-2024 and renovation works will be carried out by Police dept, at their earliest. In his augural speech Pu Lawmawma highlighted that Lunglei PS managed to bag the Best Police Station of India Award during 2022-2023.It is quite befitting that the building is also renovated to become the best PS building in Mizoram. He applauded the renovation works executed by PS staff with their all out efforts and with a spirit of love and ownership to get the best result. He exhorted them, since they could manage to bag the Best PS Award too, to try for the Best in traffic management in the whole India. He implored PS staff to be friendly and polite all the time, so that the public will not have any hesitation and fear in approaching the Police station in their time of troubles and distresses. Pu H.Ramthlengliana,IPS,DIG(SR) and Pi Ramdinliani IAS, DC delivered speeches in this function as well. Pu H.Ramthlengliana,IPS,DIG(SR) informed the gathering public how HPC had helped police dept. time and again since many past years and said that renovation works was just one amongst many. He entreated and reminded the police dept. to pay back many blessings they had received from various quarters by rendering their best services to the society. source: Mizoram Governor felicitates the first-rank holders of MBSE Class 10 & 12 Examination 71/2024-2025 Aizawl, the 27th May, 2024: Governor Dr. Hari Babu Kambhampati felicitated the first-rank holders of the High School Leaving Certificate and Higher Secondary School Leaving Certificate Examination 2024 at the Raj Bhavan, today. The topper from HSLC and three toppers from arts, commerce and science stream of HSSLC received Cash Incentives and Citations from the Governor. G overnor Dr. Hari Babu Kambhampati had an interactive session with each student and asked them about their career plans. He congratulated and conveyed his best wishes to the students and encouraged them to continue performing to the best of their abilities to secure greater success for their future career and endeavours. As per the results of the HSLC Exam and HSSLC Exam 2024 published by the Mizoram Board of School Education (MBSE) recently, Lalmoipuia Lawmzual s/o H.L. Lawmzuala, St. Paul's Higher Secondary School, Aizawl secured the First Rank in the High School Leaving Certificate Examination, 2024. Lalramdina Ralte s/o Lalthakima, St. Paul's Higher Secondary School, Aizawl is the topper in Science stream. David Lalhminghlua s/o Paul Zakhuma, St. Paul's Higher Secondary School, Aizawl is the topper in Commerce stream and Linden Lalremruatpuia s/o C. Lalrindika, Oikos Higher Secondary School, Aizawl is the topper in Arts stream, in the results of the Higher Secondary School Leaving Certificate Examinations, 2024. Attachment Loading attachment...

source: DISTRICT TASK FORCE COMMITTEE HELD EMERGENCY MEETING ON COVID-19 AT SIAHA District Task Force,Siaha mulled over how to take preventive measures against Covid-19 pandemic in the emergency meeting held, here at Siaha. District Magistrate had already issued prohibitory order on last Friday(7/3/2020), the order prohibited Cross- border movement between Myanmar and India through passages/roads that linked Myanmar and 10 villages within Siaha district namely: : Lopu, Chapi, Khaikhy, Zyhno,Lodaw, Lomasu, Iana, Siasi, Laki and Khopai village. The Same order highlighted that Check points will be set up at 3 villages namely: Kaochao, Tlapi and Tipi Ferry which located at Inter District Border. In pursuant to the said prohibitory Order, Siaha BDO and Tipa BDO have left for those 10 villages to call for GramSabha meeting and to sensitize about Covid-19 and Prohibitory Order. Today's meeting resolved that villagers of those 10 villages be requested to form a joint committee comprising of Church, NGOs and Village council to vigil over border passage/road that linked their respective village and Myanmar.The meeting also resolved that MADC Forest Guard and India Army stationed at villages located India-Myanmar Border be requested to help proposed village's Joint committee in their vigilant works on Border road/passage. Today's meeting also decided that on the 13th&14th March,2020 a Team comprising Medical officials, Leaders of NGOs, Joint VC members, Police personnel and DC office staff will visited those 13 villages and witness preventive measures taken by each village and carry out sensitization campaign as well. CMO & DMS informed the meeting that there was only one Thermal Infra Red Sensor and 15 Personal Protection Equipments (PPE) presently at Siaha; and 2 TIRS will arrive shortly. TIRS and Self Reporting Format will be placed at check points; and by using TIRS leh Self reporting format; suspected Covid-19 infected travellers will be identified and quarantine for 20 days. Tarik ni 7/3/2020 ah khan District Magistrate chuan Siaha district a khaw 10: Lopu, Chapi, Khaikhy, Zyhno,Lodaw, Lomasu, Iana, Siasi, Laki leh khopai khua te leh Myanmar inkalpawhna kawng a lo khar tawh a. He mi bakah hian Inter district Border crossing point a khaw 3: Kaochao,Tipi Ferry leh Tlapi-ah te Check post siamna tur order a lo chhuah tawh a ni. Heng khaw 13-ah te hian Gram Sabha ko-a Sentisization campaign neih turin Siaha BDO leh Tipa BDO te pawh vawiin lamah an feh chhuak tawh bawk a ni. Vawiin meeting chuan heng khaw 13 -ah te hian Kohhran,NGO leh VC te joint Committee din theuh tura ngen relin, heng Joint Committee te hian an khua nena Myanmar inkalpawhna kawng/khan te chu vil theuh tura ngen a rel bawk. An mahni puibawm turin MADC Forest dept leh Border Area khuaa India sipai awmte pawh sawm an rel bawk. Heng khaw 13-ah te hi tarik ni 13 leh 14 March,2020 khian Medical, NGO hruaitute, Joint VC hruaitute, Police leh DC office joint team te chuan tlawhin, Covid-19 laka inven nana heng khaw 13 ten Myanmar nena inkalpawhna kawng an vil dan te enpuiin, Sentisization campaign an neih zui nghal dawn a ni. Tunah hian Siaha Medical office te chuan khawsik hriat theina khawl Thermal Infra Red Sensor pakhat leh Personal Protection Equipment (PPE) 15 chauh an nei a, TIRS hi 2 a lo kal mek thu report a ni a. Heng TIRS te hi Check post pathumah an dah dawn a ni. TIRS bakah hian medical dept chuan Self Reporting Format hi check point 3 ah an dah vek ang. source: What then is the way to possess the good land? It is not so simple. Let us enumerate and review the steps. First of all, we must enjoy Christ as the redeeming lamb. We must receive Christ as our Savior. We must pass the judgment of God. This is the first step. If we have done this, we can put a check here; the first item has been passed. What is the second step? We must leave Egypt and enjoy Christ as our daily manna, as our daily life-supply. Of course, we cannot take food without drinking water; so at the same time we must enjoy Christ as the rock with the living water flowing forth. We enjoy the manna and we enjoy the rock with the living water. Do you have such an experience day by day? Many of you can boldly say that you do. Every day you enjoy Christ as your food and as your drink. Otherwise, you could not live, you could not go on, you could not maintain your life as a Christian. Day by day, we must enjoy Christ as our daily food and our living water; we must have something to eat and something to drink. Whenever we meet in the morning, instead of greeting one another with “Good morning!” let us ask “Have you eaten?” I do prefer such a greeting. Have you eaten this morning, brother? Have you drunk something this morning, sister? Some of you can answer that you have had three good meals today. Praise the Lord! We must tell people that day by day we are feeding on Christ. We are eating Christ and we are drinking Christ. If we have this experience, we can check this also.

source: CHAMPHAI DISTRICT CONSULTATIVE COMMITTEE (DCC) & DISTRICT LEVEL REVIEW COMMITTEE (DLRC) No.517/2020-2021 Champhai District Consultative Committee (DCC) & District Level Review Committee (DLRC) under the Chairmanship of Pi Maria C.T. Zuali, Deputy Commissioner Champhai held meeting today at DCâ€™s Conference Hall, the Chairman launched the Potential Credit Linked Plan (PLP) 2021-2022 for Champhai District. Chairman urged the Bankers to conduct massive and wider public awareness campaign on facilities provided through Banks. Also the Deputy Commissioner reiterated the urgency of making application forms more simplified instead of intricated forms to facilitate ease of doing business. Pu L.Lawmvela, Lead District Manager (LDM), SBI Lead Bank Office delivered welcome speech followed by discussion on the performances of Bankers and Stakeholders for the quarter ended September, 2020. According to the reporting period, Credit-Deposit (CD) ratio was 44.71 %, against the norm of 60%. Achievement under Priority Sector was 38.42 % while it was 73.43% under Non Priority Sector. Under Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana (PMMY) there were 34 beneficiaries (Sishu-20, Kishore-98, Tarun-12, Stand Up India-4) getting loan amounting rupess 200.49 lakhs. Target achievement under Government Sponsored Schemes were also discussed at length. Forty two Bakijai Cases amounting rupees 21.61 lakhs have been reported, and no recovery is reported during the quarter. Non Performing Asset (NPA) under Priority Sector was rupees 1217.20 lakhs (7.07%) while the same in Non Priority Sector was rupees 86.40 lakhs (2.25%). Annual Credit Plan Target for Financial Year 2021-2022 and PMEGP Annual Credit Plan Target were also discussed and approved at the meeting. Also Social Security Schemes, Currency remittance, Bank security, Calendar for DCC meeting and timely submission of DCC data were also discussed among other issues. As of now, there are 15 different Banks branches operating in the district; 4 Public Sector Banks, 4 Private Sector Banks, 6 Regional Rural Banks and 1 State Cooperative Bank. There are a total of 9 ATMs, 8 Business Correspondents, 1 CSP, 26 IPPB Banking Touch Points and 2 Financial Literacy Centres (Lead Bank Office, SBI Sponsored and Champhai Financial Literacy Centre, MCAB Ltd.) in the district. source: Then what will be the ultimate issue? Simply this—on the one hand, there will be the New Jerusalem, and on the other, the lake of fire. The New Jerusalem is the Triune God mingled together with the resurrected man, and the lake of fire is Satan’s ultimate destruction. The lake of fire is the place for Satan. All that is not related to the Triune God and the resurrected man will be put into the lake of fire with Satan. There will be only one tree in the New Jerusalem—the tree of life. The other tree will be in the lake of fire. This is the ultimate conclusion of the whole Scripture. The Scriptures began with three parties, but the ultimate consummation will be the New Jerusalem with only the first tree at the center of the city and the resurrected man as the expression of the Triune God. The second tree will be cast into the lake of fire. All things and all people related to the second tree will have the same destiny as Satan—in that lake of fire.

source: Meghalaya State Planning Board Chairman calls on Chief Minister No.252/2021-2022 Aizawl the 18th August, 2021: Chief Minister Pu Zoramthanga, Chairman of State Planning Board was called on by State Planning Board Chairman Pu Lambor Malngiang (MLA/MDC), Meghalaya today at the formerâ€™s office where they discussed important issues relating to economic development for both states. The Meghalaya State Planning Board Chairman expressed his gratitude for the outstanding hospitality shown by Mizoram and hoped that the bond between the two states would continue to flourish. Speaking of how he works closely with Mizo community and many sub-tribes of Mizoram in his constituency, he expressed his optimism for an enduring friendship and partnership in all sectors. Mizoram Chief Minister echoed the importance of nurturing good relations between the two states, and said that should any situation arise where Mizoram can assist Meghalaya in the development of its economy, Mizoram shall do its best. After his meeting with the Chief Minister, Pu Lambor Malngiang met with Mizoram Planning Board Vice Chairman Pu H. Rammawi followed by a meeting with NGO leaders of the state. He was accompanied by Dr. Krishna Chauhan, Expert Member (Economist) Meghalaya State Planning Board and Pu Enrich GL Nongbri, Law Department, Govt. of Meghalaya. Attachment Loading attachment...

source:
THE PRIESTHOOD WITH THE URIM
AND THE THUMMIM
The second governing principle is the priesthood under
the anointing with the urim and the thummim. What is the
priesthood? This is a wonderful and glorious matter. The
priesthood includes fellowship with the Lord and life and
service in His presence. The priesthood is a group of people
who are inconstant fellowship with the Lord. They continu-
ally commune with the Lord and serve in His presence.
They live, walk, and do everything in this way. When
we have fellowship with the Lord, when we commune with
the Lord day by day and moment by moment, and when in
this living fellowship we live, we serve, and we act, we are a
priesthood.

source: Governor Hari Babu and ITCA member discuss opportunities for students to learn space technology 102/2022-2023 Aizawl, the 28th June 2022: Dr SK Prasad, founder member and advisory council member, Indian Technology Congress Association ( ITCA) had called on Governor Hari Babu Kambhampati at the Raj Bhavan this forenoon. In this meeting, he and Governor discussed the opportunities for the students of higher secondary school, college and university in Mizoram to learn space technology. As proposed by his eminent guest, Governor Hari Babu Kambhampati welcomed the idea of selecting students with a scientific temper to have a preliminary introduction to space science with the option to continue the advanced study depending on their performance in studies. In this regard, he advised Dr SK Prasad and the institutions he represented to have close coordination with the authorities of Higher & Technical Education Department, Mizoram University, NIT Mizoram, Polytechnics, Science & Technology Department and Science Teachers Association Of Mizoram. Dr SK Prasad apprised the Governor of their initiatives in teaching the teams of students and assigning them important science projects like making mini satellites and other space technology. He explained the importance given to horning entrepreneurship skills of the students selected in this model of learning. He told Governor that his purpose of visiting is identifying the institutions with whom they will have a series of correspondences to initiate enrollment of the students in the program. reference: Governor Hari Babu leh ITCA hotupa in Mizorama zirlai thiam zual te tana space technology zir theih dan sawi dun 1070/2022-2023 Aizawl, the 28th June 2022: Vawiin chawhma khan Governor Hari Babu Kambhampati leh Dr SK Prasad, founder member and advisory council member, Indian Technology Congress Association ( ITCA), Bangalore te chu Raj Bhavan-ah an inkawm a. He hunah hian Mizorama zirlai thiam filawr te zinga space technology zir duh thlan chhuah dan tur leh an zir theih dan tur te an sawi dun a ni. Governor Hari Babu Kambhampati chuan Mizorama zirlaite chu lehkha thiam thei tak leh hmundanga zirlaite el phaka thluak tha an ni tih a sawi a. Space technology pawh a zirna kawng a inhawn phawt chuan hlawhtling takin an zir thei turah angai tih a sawi a ni. Governor chuan Dr SK Prasad leh a thawhna hmuna thuneituten Mizoramah zirlai te tan Space Technology zir theihna hun remchang an rawn zawn sak chu lawmawm a tih thu a sawi a. Hemi kawngah hian ITCA hotute chuan Higher & Technical Education Department, Mizoram University, NIT Mizoram, Polytechnics, Science & Technology Department leh Science Teachers Association Of Mizoram berawn se. Anni nena indawrna kaltlang hian zirlai thiam thei zual zinga space technology zir duhte thlanchhuah a awlsam a rin thu a sawi a ni. Dr SK Prasad chuan Prime Minister hmathlir angin India thalaite chu space technology lamah thiamna sang zawk nei tur leh India ram chu a hmahruaitu a nih theih nan chher hriam mek an ni a ti a. He hmalakna kal zelah hian zirlai team 75 te chu kumina project 75 thawk zo hman turin Students' Satellites 75 project hnuaiah satellite te chi(mini satellite) siam turin thlan an ni dawn an a ti. He project-ah hian India rama zirlaite zawng zawng an inel dawn a team 75 thlan an ni dawn a ti a. He project-ah hian Mizorama zirlaite tan pawh tel theihna hun a inhawng thei dawn niin a sawi a ni. Dr Prasad chuan a lo kal chhan tak chu Higher Secondary atanga University Degree zirlaite tan Space Technology zirna an kalpui mek chu Mizorama zirlaite rawn hmelhriat tir a ni a ti a. Hemi kawngah hian Governor leh state sawrkar hotute thlawpna a rawn ngen bakah a bikin science lam zirna kaihhnawiha hotute thawhpuiah a rawn sawm tih a sawi bawk a ni. source: CHAMPHAI DISTRICT TASK FORCE ON CORONA VIRUS OUTBREAK HELD MEETING In pursuance of the decision made by Mizoram State Level Task Force on Mitigation of Corona Virus, Champhai District Task Force on Corona Virus was formed recently and held its first meeting at DC Conference Hall, yesterday. The meeting was presided over by Pu SL Naveen, IAS Deputy Commissioner Champhai. Given its strategic location, Champhai district being located nearby International Border, the meeting mentioned the needs for proper medical screening at Zokhawthar and restriction on movement particularly travellers based on their travelling history. To boost up the preventive measures, the meeting highlighted the importance of fostering better coordination with the neighbouring district administration of Myanmar. The meeting decided to organize awareness campaigns for villages nearby border areas and preparation of isolation ward for quarantine in case any suspect is detected. CMO Office was assigned to prepare budget encompassing all requirements for further submission to the higher authority. At the border Town of Zokhawthar, Government of Mizoram has been monitoring the situation and is conducting Medical Screening since the 4th of February 2020 with proper Self Reporting Form. source: MIZORAM POLICE PRESS STATEMENT 67/2023-2024 PUBLIC ADVISORY ON DIGITAL PAYMENT FRAUD With the increasing use of Digital Payment Systems, Mizoram has also witnessed a sharp increase in digital payment frauds. Cyber fraudsters are finding new methods to dupe vulnerable and unsuspecting citizens. Online financial frauds account for more than 75% of all cyber-crimes reported in the State. With an aim to prevent financial losses to the general public through online frauds, Mizoram Police once again appeals to public to take following precautions: 1. Never share your Banking password, OTP (one time password) or Debit/Credit Card details with others. 2. Never scan QR Code, when you are to receive money. It is only required for transferring money to other accounts. 3. Beware of phishing scams trying to steal your Banking or UPI information. Look out for fake emails and websites, that try to collect information and do not click on unknownâ€™unfamiliar links. 4. Always use familiar websites for online shopping rather than shopping by searching products on search engines. Search results can be misleading and may lead to malicious websites. 5. Ignore advertisements/deals, if they claim that you can earn money with little or no work or you can make money on an investment with little or no risk. If an offer seems too good to be true, it is most likely to be a scam. 6. Beware of fake loan apps that provide quick and easy loans. Such illegal apps will seek a variety of information and permissions from applicants, which is then misused to blackmail them later. If using digital loan app, please ensure that it has RBI authorization. 7. Beware of fraudsters, who impersonate as army/police personnel advertising cheap items online. We urge citizens to exercise extreme caution, while conducting financial transactions online. If you are a victim of financial fraud, call Cyber Helpline 1930 or register your complaints on www.cybercrime.gov.in . STEP BY STEP GUIDE ON REGISTRATION OF COMPLAINT AT www.cybercrime.gov.in : 1.
